listing.name: Wave Race 64: Recompiled
listing.summary: Native Wave Race 64 recompilation. Portcove installs the official Windows package; on Linux, download the upstream package and maintain it yourself.

steps.title: Windows: use a copy you already prepared
steps.instruction: On Windows, choose Install for the copy Portcove manages. To keep playing a copy you extracted yourself, select WaveRace64Recomp.exe with its folder as the working directory and leave arguments empty. You and upstream maintain that copy.

steps.title: Linux: download and extract the package
steps.instruction: Download the official package ending in -linux-x86_64.tar.gz and extract the whole folder somewhere writable. Install the SDL2, GTK 3, FreeType and Vulkan packages named in its README-LINUX.txt. The inspected v1.0.2 program needs glibc 2.43 and libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.32.

steps.title: Linux: choose your original game
steps.instruction: Run WaveRace64Recomp.sh, choose Load ROM and select your own Wave Race 64 (USA) (Rev A) original. You maintain this copy: replace it yourself when upstream publishes a new version.

warnings: The package contains recompiled game code; some bundled components have their own notices. Use only your own original game.

references.title: Find your saves and settings
references.instruction: A copy with an empty portable.txt beside the program keeps saves and settings in its own folder: the saves folder and the .json settings files. Without it, Windows uses %LOCALAPPDATA%\WaveRace64Recomp and Linux uses $XDG_DATA_HOME/WaveRace64Recomp, usually ~/.local/share/WaveRace64Recomp. Back these up before replacing a copy you maintain.

references.title: Move from a Windows copy you added earlier
references.instruction: A v1.0.2 folder you added to Portcove keeps working where it is. Portcove doesn't copy its saves or settings into a managed copy. To switch, close the game and back up that folder's saves folder and .json settings files. Remove the registration (your files stay in place) and choose Install. Then, with the game closed, open the managed game's saved data folder from its details and copy the saves folder and .json files into it.

presentation.manual_preparation: Choose your own Wave Race 64 (USA) (Rev A) original. Portcove installs the unchanged official v1.0.2 Windows package, prepares the original beside the game and creates portable.txt so saves, settings and mods stay with the managed copy. Choose Start Game in the launcher. Portcove has not tested gameplay.
